config.label: LexAPI API key
config.description: LexAPI API key. Get one at https://lex-api.com/dashboard (FREE plan available; see https://lex-api.com/pricing).

config.label: Override the LexAPI base URL
config.description: Override the LexAPI base URL. Defaults to https://lex-api.com/api/v1.

config.label: Set to true to hide every non-read-only tool (webhook create/update/delete/test, citation extraction)
config.description: Set to true to hide every non-read-only tool (webhook create/update/delete/test, citation extraction).

config.label: Deadline per tool call in milliseconds, retries included (default 55000)
config.description: Deadline per tool call in milliseconds, retries included (default 55000). Raise only together with the MCP client timeout.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Leave unset to sign in with LexAPI (OAuth 2.1; the server's 401 points clients to https://mcp.lex-api.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/v1). Or send "Bearer <your LexAPI API key>" from https://lex-api.com/dashboard (FREE plan available; see https://lex-api.com/pricing).
